values.DataCenterNotes: Summit Midstream's August 2026 release on the Double E expansion names data center development in Texas and New Mexico as a new source of demand for Double E, beyond the expansion capacity to Waha. No specific data center is named. Trade press repeats the same statement.

verifications.note: Summit Midstream release lists growth from data center developments in Texas and New Mexico for Double E.
Trade press repeats Summit's statement on data center demand for Double E.

records.researcher_notes: Summit Midstream's August 2026 release says data center development in Texas and New Mexico is a demand growth opportunity for Double E. No campus is named. The pipeline press story repeats the same release.

values.DataCenterNotes: In March 2024 EQT's chief executive said power demand from AI data centers in the southeastern market is something Mountain Valley Pipeline is set to serve. No specific data center is named.

verifications.note: Bloomberg story says EQT's chief executive tied Mountain Valley Pipeline to AI data center power demand in the Southeast.

records.researcher_notes: A March 2024 Bloomberg story, run by Data Center Knowledge, quotes EQT's chief executive saying the pipeline will serve rising data center power demand in the Southeast. No campus is named.

values.DataCenterNotes: Williams' December 2025 fact sheet for Constitution cites data center and manufacturing construction as a reason the Northeast needs the pipeline. It says the Northeast got only 2 percent of national data center construction spending from 2020 to 2024. No specific data center is named.

verifications.note: Williams Constitution fact sheet lists lagging data center and manufacturing investment in the Northeast among the reasons for the pipeline.

records.researcher_notes: The developer's own December 2025 Constitution fact sheet names data centers among the economic reasons for the pipeline. It is one of several drivers and no customer is named.

ledger.note: Summit Midstream August 2026 release names data center growth as a demand opportunity for Double E.

The June 2025 Southwest Ledger article says Energy Transfer will connect a Chickasha data center gas plant to one of two lines near the airport but does not name Enable Gas Transmission, and a search found nothing newer.
Williams' own December 2025 Constitution fact sheet cites data center investment as part of the case.
EQT's chief executive tied Mountain Valley Pipeline to AI data center power demand in March 2024.
